items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I was just more influenced by Charlie Parker and Stan Getz and Lee Konitz, that type of thing.

ctx.x: Who were the other jazz players that you’ve listened to and enjoyed or not enjoyed?

I listen to a lot of the people like Hubert Laws and Joe Farrell. In fact most of my influence has been more like saxophone players you see. So that’s why I associate the bebop thing and the style plus my own whatever I do with those influences. So it seems like I listen to more saxophone players than flutists. I like a lot of these people. I was just more influenced by Charlie Parker and Stan Getz and Lee Konitz, that type of thing.
You had some pretty nice compliments from — Charles Mingus called you the world’s greatest jazz flute player.
